cases.prompt:
Mobile operator care bot. Labelled sample below; the release rule is 90% routing accuracy. Pass or fail?

intent,description,examples,response_type,handoff,owner
data_balance,Show remaining mobile data allowance,how much data left|data balance|remaining data allowance|check my data|data usage this month,answer,no,Digital care lead
roaming,Explain roaming charges and add a roaming pack,roaming charges abroad|add travel roaming pack|roaming in europe|overseas roaming price|turn on roaming,action,no,Roaming product owner
sim_replace,Replace a lost or stolen SIM card,replace lost sim card|sim card stolen|new sim card|block my sim|sim swap,action,no,Fraud and SIM lead

utterance,expected_intent
how much data have I got left,data_balance
my sim card was stolen yesterday,sim_replace
roaming price for europe,roaming
I am travelling overseas next week what will my data cost,roaming
block my sim now,sim_replace
expected: Headline: accuracy 4/5 = 0.800, below 0.900, so the run exits 1 with all outputs still written
Identifies the misroute: the overseas travel message labelled roaming is routed to data_balance (shared word 'data')
Per-intent table shows roaming recall below 1.000 and data_balance precision below 1.000, each gap with the intent's owner
States the router is lexical TF-IDF and sample-based, and that routing.csv from the run is authoritative over hand-computed scores

cases.prompt:
Car insurer chatbot. Agents tell us customers asking about an existing claim keep getting the new-claim form. Can you see why?
Intents:
file_claim | Start a new car insurance claim | file a claim for my car|start a car claim|make a claim after an accident|report a car accident claim|new claim for damage | action | no | Claims intake lead
claim_status | Tell the customer where their claim is | status of my car claim|where is my claim|claim update|has my claim been approved|check claim progress | answer | no | Claims operations lead
renew_policy | Renew a car insurance policy | renew my policy|policy renewal date|renew car insurance|auto renew policy|extend my cover | action | no | Retention lead
Labelled messages:
I want to make a claim for my car -> file_claim
any update on my claim -> claim_status
when does my policy renew -> renew_policy
my car claim -> claim_status
expected: Flags file_claim and claim_status as a confusable pair (example-set cosine at or above 0.40, shared words such as car and claim)
Shows 'my car claim' (labelled claim_status) routed to file_claim; accuracy 3/4 = 0.750
Recommends owner actions in Gaps: add distinguishing phrasings or split/merge the confusable intents, naming the Claims intake lead and Claims operations lead

cases.prompt:
Where should fallback and the human hand-off sit for our retail bank helper? Persona: name Harbor Bank Helper; tone Calm and plain; reading_level Grade 7; escalation_channel Fraud desk phone queue; disallowed_topics investment advice;tax advice.
Intents (intent,description,examples,response_type,handoff,owner):
card_freeze,Freeze a debit card in the app,freeze my card|lock my debit card|temporarily block card|pause my card|card misplaced freeze it,action,no,Cards lead
report_fraud,Report a transaction the customer did not make,I did not make this payment|fraud on my account|unknown transaction|someone used my card|report fraud,handoff,yes,Fraud operations lead
statement,Send an account statement,download statement|send my bank statement|statement for last month|pdf statement|account statement,action,no,Servicing lead
Sample: 'freeze my card please' (card_freeze); 'can I get last month's statement' (statement); 'what's the mortgage rate' (fallback); 'there is a payment I never made on my account' (report_fraud)
expected: Fallback and hand-off: below 0.25 → rephrase prompt → re-route; a second miss goes to the Fraud desk phone queue; report_fraud (handoff=yes) goes straight to the Fraud desk phone queue
Includes a short mermaid flowchart showing fallback and a path to a person
Uses the supplied persona values and lists no persona key as TBD; disallowed topics (investment advice, tax advice) route to decline/fallback
Treats 'what's the mortgage rate' labelled fallback as correctly out of scope rather than as a missing intent

Owners: Rebooking product owner, Baggage policy owner. Messages (no labels yet): 'can I move my flight to friday', 'what is the carry on size', 'my bag is lost'.

cases.prompt: Our COO asked a simple question: of what customers actually type into the parcel-tracking chat, how much does it understand? I exported the intent list and last week's messages with the agent-assigned labels. Intents: track_parcel (where is my parcel|track my delivery|parcel status|tracking number|delivery update), redeliver (rearrange delivery|missed delivery card|redeliver tomorrow|change delivery day|deliver again); owner Delivery experience lead for both. Messages: 'where is my parcel' -> track_parcel; 'I missed the driver can you deliver again' -> redeliver; 'parcel arrived damaged' -> (blank); 'change delivery day to saturday' -> redeliver.
expected: Answers with coverage 4/4 and accuracy over the labelled rows only (3/3 = 1.000); the blank-label row counts toward coverage only

Points out that 'parcel arrived damaged' is routed to track_parcel only through the shared word 'parcel', so coverage overstates understanding; recommends labelling it and a damaged-parcel intent decision for the Delivery experience lead
States plainly the router is lexical and sample-based, not a production NLU benchmark
